blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang has already slipped out of the country through unofficial channels, Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla confirmed on Tuesday. “Backdoor siya (nakabas),” Remulla said in an interview in Makati City.
